limitations: Short sequential observations, not a performance benchmark or a smoothness comparison.
Workload and network were not held constant.
RSS high-water measurements were cumulative across child runs, so no memory comparison is asserted.
The new structured reader initially fell back to ss on Snap because accepted sshd sockets retained root ownership; the final Snap pilot used the narrow exact inherited SSH connection exception.
Starship remained in away mode; no display workload or transport matrix was run.
Existing production recorders retained version 1.7.0 until the next deliberate launch/reset.
